units.title: Moisture Content Checks of Processed Rice

learning_outcomes.description: Outline the procedure of Moisture Content Checks for Processed Rice

performance_criteria.description: Sample of processed rice for testing.
Make decision on which method to use
prepare samples for testing according to the method's requirements
Describe the process of moisture content test

learning_outcomes.description: Perform the Process of Moisture Content Checks using oven-drying method

performance_criteria.description: Carry out sampling by taking a representative rice sample (about 5-10 grams)
Perform weighing of the sample and record the initial weight (W ) of the 1 sample using a digital balance.
Set oven temperature to a controlled value (usually 130°C for rice)
Dry the sample by placing the sample in the oven for a specified time (e.g., 1-2 hours)
Carry out cooling of the sample by transferring it to a desiccator to cool
Perform weighing of the dried sample and record the final weight (W ) 2
Calculate moisture content: Moisture content (%) = [(W – W ) / 1 2 W ] × 100 1
Perform routine maintenance of equipment used for moisture content check to ensure accuracy and reliability

learning_outcomes.description: Apply the Process of Moisture Content Checks using moisture meter method following the meter's specification (e.g., insert probe into the sample or place sample in the meter)

performance_criteria.description: Set the correct grain type (rice) on the moisture meter if applicable
Carry out sampling by filling the meter's sample cup or chamber with a representative rice sample
Insert the probe or sample by
Take the readings by pressing the test button to get the moisture content (%)
Take multiple readings for accuracy
Record the results by noting the moisture content reading on the meter's display
Perform routine maintenance of equipment used for moisture content check to ensure accuracy and reliability
